explanation: States P ≠ NP for these classes. P is the set of L : List Bool → Bool that are poly-time computable via Mathlib's TM2ComputableInPolyTime, using the repo's BitstringEncoding (lists encode each bit as a 3-bit self-delimiting block, a linear blow-up). NP is defined by a poly-time verifier R on (x, w) pairs, using the self-delimiting encoding delimit(x) ++ w, with witnesses of length ≤ p(|x|). This matches Arora–Barak Def. 2.1. All the encodings are polynomially equivalent to standard ones, so the statement is the faithful P vs NP question.
